pages.text: A Parchtear is an Arcane Gem formed from a black-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in an pendeloque cut.$(br2)When activated, the Parchtear destroys a radius 1 cuboid area of fluid. If you are sneaking, it instead destroys a single block of fluid. Each fluid block destroyed consumes a point of charge.
Once fluid has been destroyed, other fluid is blocked from flowing into the same space for ten seconds.
Parchtear can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
